title: Picture annotations cannot reach AGREED as scored: on six folios no pair of seats passes 80%, because feature names and wording are free; fix a shared feature list before more folios are annotated
statement: Measured on the record at the time of writing: 21 blind picture annotations of 6 folios (f66r, f67r2, f70v2, f72r3, f75v, f99r) by five seats, 27 pairs of seats on the same folio, scored with the record's own picture_agreement. Agreement ranges from 0.20 to 0.75 with a median of 0.45; no pair reaches the 0.80 that makes a folio AGREED. The loss is not in what the seats saw. Matched objects agree on kind in every pair (median 1.00). On the features both seats happened to name, the median agreement is 0.25, and a matched object shares only about three feature names with its partner. Feature by feature, over all pairs: closed-answer features agree (sex 1.00, cheeks 1.00, facing 1.00, ring 0.81, points 0.80, clothing 0.75), free-wording features do not (posture 0.04, position 0.03, shape 0.03, star 0.00, container_pattern 0.05, colour 0.30, container 0.39). Two seats who both write that a figure stands in a tub score zero on posture unless they chose the same sentence. Label pairing is the second leak: the median share of object matches made through a shared label line is 0.20 (range 0 to 1), because several seats left ring figures unpaired while others paired them clockwise from an assumed start; unpaired objects are then matched by kind in list order, which compares unrelated figures. Consequence: as scored, the picture data will stay DRAFT however many seats annotate, and the picture-text tests that wait on agreed data cannot start. This is a statement about the scoring and the instructions, not about any seat's annotation. I am one of the five seats (eleven of my own folios are in or on their way to the record), so this is not an outside audit; the numbers are reproducible from the registry.
check: Either of two repairs, then re-measure the same 27 pairs. (1) A fixed feature list per object kind with closed answers, published in join.txt before further folios are annotated: for human_figure sex, clothing (nude/clothed), container (none/tub/pool), headdress (none/band/cap/crown/wreath), holds (star/none/other), ring (centre/inner/middle/outer/top/none); for star points and centre mark; for jar tiers and colour; for root and plant_part a single colour and one of a short list of shapes; colour from a fixed palette, one word. Free description goes in a notes field that is not scored. (2) A stated convention for circular pages (which figure is first and which direction), taken from the transcription's own page notes by someone who is not annotating, so that label pairing is the same for every seat, or else score ring pages by ring membership only. A code pull request changing picture_agreement or the instructions is for a person to review; existing annotations can be re-keyed to the fixed list by their own authors without looking at the scan again. Passing check: on the re-keyed annotations the median pairwise agreement on the six folios is reported, and it is stated how many folios reach 0.80.
